children: Ocean Power Technologies announced financing-related changes, exchanging its Series C-1 Convertible Notes for new Series D Convertible Notes and amending the pricing of its June 2026 common warrants. The Series D Notes cut the conversion price to $2.45 and add an alternative conversion at 93% of the lowest seven-day VWAP, defer amortization to January 1, 2027, carry 4.5% interest (13% upon default), and mature in 18 months at a 13% premium. The company also reduced the warrant exercise price to $2.45 to align with the new note terms, while maintaining ownership and exchange caps under NYSE American rules.
